scope: Hunter’s Hill Council South Ward by-election

sources.title: NSWEC Hunter’s Hill Council South Ward by-election ballot paper draw order
sources.supports: Post-draw candidate table lists 4 candidates in official ballot order, with affiliations as printed.

sources.title: NSWEC Hunter’s Hill Council South Ward by-election notice of contested election
sources.supports: Election notice 3 dated 12 November confirms a contested poll on 12 December, 8 am–6 pm AEDT, with postal receipt by 6 pm AEDT on 29 December.

observations: Hunter’s Hill Council South Ward by-election: Nominations closed at noon AEDT on 11 November. NSWEC published 4 candidates in the 12 November ballot draw order. Voting remains scheduled for 12 December, 8 am to 6 pm AEDT. Postal vote receipt closes 29 December at 6 pm AEDT.
